scripts.build: npm run build -w @probably-this-way/contracts && npm run build -w @probably-this-way/api && npm run build -w @probably-this-way/web
scripts.check: npm run build -w @probably-this-way/contracts && npm run check -w @probably-this-way/api && npm run check -w @probably-this-way/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @probably-this-way/contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan npm:dev:api npm:dev:web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @probably-this-way/contracts && npm run test -w @probably-this-way/api
